The lap wrote the caveat into the Abstract and into 4.3's third caveat and paid for it by replacing 4.5's 43-word statement with a 9-word back-reference. The lap asserted that README.md:626 cites paper/manuscript.md 4.5 for the upper-bound caveat. It does not; :626 is the English abstract draft and carries no citation at all. The citing line is README.md:38, the TL;DR bullet -- CHARTER 14b's first-named judge-facing surface -- which the lap never identified. A hand-typed line number about this repository's own judge-facing surface, repeated into STATE.json, GAPS.md and paper/README.md, is the exact class DIRECTION bans, and the lap did not run DIRECTION's subject grep that would have caught it. (2) THE FIX DELETED THE TEXT README:38 CITES. grep -niE 'noiseless|upper bound' matched manuscript.md:512 in 4.5 before the diff and matched nothing in 4.5 after it. README:38 would have been left citing a section silent on the claim it quotes -- STRICTLY WORSE than the scope mismatch the lap set out to fix -- and CHARTER 12 bars this routine from repairing README.md. (3) THE ABSTRACT CLAUSE INVERTED THE BOUND. It read 'bounds a noiseless forecast rather than this model'. Everywhere else the repository states this -- README:36-38, README:626, docs/present_perimeter_arm.md 5 -- 42 is an upper bound ON THIS MODEL and EQUALS what a noiseless forecast would buy. The lap's wording says the number bounds the noiseless forecast and explicitly not this model, which a reader can take as 'this model may do better': the inverse of the safety-relevant meaning, on the headline number, in the most-read block of the paper, in the diff whose whole purpose was to make two surfaces agree. It also dropped the direction word 'upper' that DIRECTION:59 names. Separately, the merged lead's second clause had no premise anywhere in 4.3: the sentence that established it was the one deleted from 4.5, so the paragraph jumped to a conclusion whose mechanism had left the section. AND ONE THE REVIEWER FOUND INSIDE THIS ROUTINE'S OWN FILE: paper/GAPS.md row G8 asserts 'and 4.5 states both: the forecast-aware arm plans on the field it is graded against...'. The diff would have made that false, in a live gap row, in a file the lap was editing in the same diff, and left it standing. WHY IT WAS REVERTED RATHER THAN REPAIRED, AND THIS IS NH-037'S ANSWER. The correct version needs the mechanism stated once with its premise (about 48 words in a fourth 4.3 caveat), 4.5's original 43-word scoped statement KEPT so README:38's citation survives, a corrected Abstract clause (about +23), and 7, which the tripwire also enumerates.
